entries.en: The kernel’s pager retrieved the missing page from disk when the program accessed that address.
entries.zh: 程序访问那个地址时，内核的页调度程序从磁盘取回了缺失的内存页。

entries.en: The technician lowered the mixer’s slider to reduce the volume in the left channel.
entries.zh: 技术人员拉低调音台上的滑动器，降低左声道的音量。

entries.en: The disk scan found an orphaned file with no directory entry pointing to it.
entries.zh: 磁盘扫描发现了一个孤立文件，没有任何目录项指向它。

entries.en: Her late-night jazz programme finally reached the airwaves after a year of planning.
entries.zh: 经过一年的筹划，她的深夜爵士节目终于通过广播波道播出了。

entries.en: The dog landed on all fours after jumping down from the low wall.
entries.zh: 那条狗从矮墙跳下，四足落地。

entries.en: The unused guest room became an apple of discord when both sisters wanted it as a studio.
entries.zh: 两姐妹都想把那间闲置的客房当作工作室，它因此成了争执的祸根。

entries.en: Rust covered the anchor ring, but the chain attached to it was still visible.
entries.zh: 锚环上覆着锈，但接在它上面的链条仍然可见。

entries.en: The plant’s inspection log recorded a crack in the steel ash bin.
entries.zh: 工厂的检查日志记录了钢制灰仓的一条裂缝。

entries.en: The camera received new exposure settings over the back channel while video travelled in the opposite direction.
entries.zh: 视频沿相反方向传输时，摄像机通过反向信道接收了新的曝光设置。

entries.en: The antenna’s radio reflector was dented during transport, so the team checked its alignment.
entries.zh: 天线的无线电反射器在运输中出现了凹痕，因此小组检查了它的对准情况。

entries.en: The map marks the old ordnance store beside the barracks, not inside the fortress.
entries.zh: 地图把旧军械库标在营房旁，而不是堡垒内。

entries.en: The café plans to pipe in music from a player in the back room.
entries.zh: 咖啡馆计划通过音响系统播放后屋播放器里的音乐。

entries.en: We will dig in the compost before planting the young tomato plants.
entries.zh: 种番茄幼苗之前，我们会翻土把堆肥掺进去。

entries.en: The defender had to kick the ball out over the touchline to stop the attack.
entries.zh: 防守队员不得不把球从边线踢出界，以阻止这次进攻。

entries.en: The child tried to kick the ball back to her friend, but it rolled into the flowerbed.
entries.zh: 孩子想把球踢回给朋友，球却滚进了花坛。

entries.en: The conservator found a labelled tin of whiting beside the old glazing putty.
entries.zh: 修复人员在旧玻璃油灰旁发现了一个贴着标签、装有白垩粉的罐子。

entries.en: The code review found an unnecessary widening from a 32-bit integer to a 64-bit integer.
entries.zh: 代码审查发现了一次不必要的从32位整数到64位整数的拓宽转换。

entries.en: The print shop’s ledger records the cost of typecasting separately from the cost of setting the pages.
entries.zh: 印刷厂的账本将铸字费用与页面排字费用分开记录。

entries.en: The maintenance record shows a clogged after-filter downstream of the air dryer.
entries.zh: 维修记录显示，空气干燥器下游的后过滤器堵塞了。
